provenance.note: GENRE: an open hat rings 200-400 ms, and that ring is most of what makes a house loop breathe. Its ring drifts over about twenty-four bars, phased off the room's own hat numbers, so sixteen bars of a loop are not sixteen bars of one sample; the delay send is real.

notes.grain: SPARK-2: the grain the room's `hats` block holds (`top`, `air`, `tail`, nought in every table; `hat-grain.ts`): metal above 8 kHz, air past the lid from `airHz`, the tail after -10 dB. A place writes them; nought builds nothing.
